exclusions: KiCad per-user .kicad_prl state is not a design deliverable.

Run logs, ERC/DRC reports and validation/manifest envelopes are authenticated or independently passed per run, not compared byte-for-byte; they contain per-run paths, times or raw timestamp-bound hashes.
normalization_policy: Only the explicit native timestamp fields listed per file are normalized in memory. Geometry, all other metadata, coordinates, units, layer identity and BOM values remain significant. Original files are not written.
